details: Reports confirm a peace agreement between the United States and Iran, expected to be formally signed on June 19. This breakthrough aims to end hostilities, facilitate the reopening of the crucial Strait of Hormuz, and lift a U.S. naval blockade. The de-escalation of tensions has sparked a significant "risk-on" sentiment across global financial markets, leading to a notable drop in crude oil prices and a rally in equities. In the cryptocurrency market, Bitcoin has surged past $65,000, with Ethereum and other major altcoins also experiencing substantial gains as investors move back into risk assets.
title: US-Iran Peace Deal Calms Tensions, Fuels Crypto Rally

details: Taiwan is reportedly evaluating the inclusion of Bitcoin in its strategic reserve strategy. This consideration stems from growing concerns over potential geopolitical tensions with China and the perceived vulnerability of its substantial foreign reserves, primarily held in US dollar-denominated assets, to international sanctions or disruptions. The discussions underscore a broader trend where governments and institutions globally are increasingly looking at decentralized digital assets like Bitcoin as a potential seizure-resistant alternative to enhance long-term financial resilience.
title: Taiwan Considers Bitcoin as Strategic Reserve Amid Geopolitical Concerns
